title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
林云脸上的得意与狞笑瞬间凝固，取而代之的是浓浓的骇然与不可置信。怎么可能？！他这一拳，灌注了淬体境九重的全力，就算是一块青石，也足以轰出裂纹！可楚皓这个废物，这个传闻中连淬体境四重都未突破的家伙，竟然……竟然如此轻描淡写地接住了？不，绝不可能！一定是错觉！“给我……开！”林云怒吼，手臂青筋暴起，试图将拳头从楚皓的掌握中抽出，或者，更进一步，将楚皓整个人震退。然而，楚皓的手掌如同一只铁钳，不，比铁钳更为坚固，纹丝不动。林云感觉自己的拳头像是轰在了一座太古神山之上，所有的力量都如泥牛入海，消失得无影无踪。楚皓嘴角噙着一抹淡淡的，甚至可以说是戏谑的笑容，手腕微微一紧。“咔嚓！”一声令人牙酸的轻响，伴随着林云骤然拔高的惨叫。“啊——！”林云只觉得一股无法抗拒的巨力从楚皓的掌心传来，他的指骨、腕骨仿佛都要被生生捏碎，剧痛如潮水般瞬间席卷全身。他甚至能清晰地感觉到，自己拳头上的骨节正在错位、变形！“嘶——”大厅内，响起一片倒吸凉气的声音。那些原本等着看楚皓笑话的宾客，此刻一个个眼珠子都快瞪出来了。“这……这怎么回事？”“楚皓他……他不是淬体三重吗？”“林云可是淬体九重巅峰啊！一招……不，连一招都算不上，就被制住了？”楚山河更是面如土色，他张大了嘴，看着眼前这一幕，大脑一片空白。这个还是他那个不成器的儿子吗？楚皓看着林云痛得扭曲的脸，轻笑一声：“就这点微末道行，也敢学人强出头？聒噪。”话音未落，他手腕随意一抖。林云那一百多斤的身体，就像一个破败的稻草人，被楚皓轻飘飘地甩了出去。“呼——砰！哗啦啦——”林云在空中划过一道狼狈的弧线，接连撞翻了两三张红木桌案，杯盘碗碟碎裂一地，最后重重摔在地上，激起一片尘土。“噗——”他刚一落地，便猛地喷出一大口鲜血，脸色惨白如纸，挣扎着想要爬起来，却感觉胸口剧痛，浑身骨头像散了架一般，提不起丝毫力气。他再看向楚皓时，那眼神中哪还有半分倨傲，只剩下深深的恐惧与怨毒。一招！不，甚至连一招都算不上！青阳城年轻一代的翘楚，半只脚踏入凝气境的林云，就这么……败了？败得如此彻底，如此干脆利落！整个楚家大厅，陷入了一种诡异的死寂。落针可闻。所有人的目光，都汇聚在那个依旧站在原地，仿佛只是拍了拍苍蝇般轻松写意的少年身上。楚皓，这个他们印象中唯唯诺诺、资质平庸的废物，此刻却如同一柄出鞘的利剑，锋芒毕露，令人不敢直视。萧清雪那双清冷如秋水的凤眸中，第一次泛起了剧烈的波澜。她紧紧盯着楚皓，那张绝美的容颜上，罕见地露出一丝讶异。这个刚刚还被她视作耻辱，恨不得立刻撇清关系的“未婚夫”，竟然隐藏着如此实力？三十年河东，三十年河西，莫欺少年穷……那句狂言，此刻在她脑海中回荡，竟有了一丝别样的意味。难道，他并非虚张声势？“小畜生！你竟敢下如此重手！”一声雷霆般的怒吼打破了寂静。萧云峰脸色铁青，须发戟张，一股属于聚灵境强者的恐怖威压，如同实质的潮水般向楚皓汹涌而去。大厅内的空气仿佛都凝固了，修为稍弱的宾客只觉得胸口发闷，呼吸困难，更有甚者双腿发软，几乎要瘫倒在地。

“伤我萧家看中的人，你找死！”萧云峰眼中杀机暴涌，显然是动了真怒。林云虽然不是萧家人，但他是为了萧清雪出头，如今当着他的面被楚皓如此羞辱性地击败，等同于打了萧家的脸。然而，面对这股足以让淬体境武者肝胆俱裂的威压，楚皓却只是轻轻拍了拍手掌，仿佛掸去根本不存在的灰尘。他甚至还伸了个懒腰，骨骼发出一阵噼里啪啦的轻响，一种难以言喻的舒畅感传遍全身。混沌圣体，果然非同凡响！仅仅是初步觉醒，这肉身强度便已如此惊人，连聚灵境的威压，似乎也削弱了大半。他抬起眼皮，平静地看向暴怒的萧云峰，嘴角勾起一抹若有若无的弧度：“技不如人，挨打也是活该。怎么，老的打不过，小的就不能还手了？还是说，萧长老打算亲自下场，以大欺小？”“你！”萧云峰气得七窍生烟，这小子不仅废了林云，还敢如此顶撞他！他堂堂萧家长老，聚灵境强者，何曾受过这等挑衅？“好个牙尖嘴利的小子！今日老夫便替你爹娘好好管教管教你！”萧云峰怒喝一声，体内元力鼓荡，眼看就要悍然出手。就在这时，一道清冷的声音响起。“萧长老，且慢。”萧清雪莲步轻移，走到了场中，挡在了楚皓与萧云峰之间。她依旧是一身白衣，不染尘埃，但此刻，她那双看向楚皓的眸子，却充满了前所未有的复杂。有震惊，有审视，也有一丝难以察觉的……好奇。她深吸一口气，目光从楚皓身上移开，转向萧云峰，微微欠身：“萧长老，此事因我而起，还请长老暂息雷霆之怒。”萧云峰眉头一皱：“清雪，这小子……”萧清雪却打断了他，再次看向楚皓，声音清冷依旧，却多了一分郑重：“楚皓，你的实力，的确出乎了所有人的意料，也包括我。”她顿了顿，似乎在斟酌措辞，片刻后才继续说道：“今日之事，你羞辱我萧家在先，但林云挑衅你也是事实。我可以暂且不追究你今日的狂言与出手伤人。”此言一出，满座皆惊。萧清雪竟然……不追究了？楚皓挑了挑眉，饶有兴致地看着她，想知道这位天之骄女葫芦里卖的什么药。只听萧清雪继续道：“三个月后，便是青阳城三年一度的青阳大比。届时，青阳城所有年轻一辈的翘楚都会参加。你若能在那场大比中，夺得魁首……”她说到这里，清冷的目光中闪过一丝锐利的光芒，紧紧锁住楚皓：“若你能夺魁，今日你我两家以及你对我的羞辱，可以一笔勾销，甚至……我们可以重新商议其他。但，倘若你做不到……”她没有把话说完，但那未尽之言中的威胁与冰冷，却让在场所有人都打了个寒颤。青阳大比魁首？大厅内顿时响起一阵压抑不住的议论声。“开什么玩笑？青阳大比魁首？那可是凝气境高手的舞台！”“楚皓就算隐藏了实力，顶天了也就淬体境巅峰吧？想拿魁首，痴人说梦！”“萧小姐这分明是给了他一个不可能完成的任务啊！”楚山河一颗心更是沉到了谷底，这条件，比直接翻脸好不了多少。然而，出乎所有人意料，楚皓闻言，非但没有丝毫惧色，反而嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹自信的笑容：“青阳大比魁首么？”他伸出小指，懒洋洋地掏了掏耳朵，仿佛没听清一般，随即目光一凝，直视萧清雪那双深邃的凤眸：“好，我楚皓接下了！区区青阳大比魁首而已，三个月，足够了。”他顿了顿，笑容中带着一丝玩味：“只希望到时候，萧小姐可不要食言才好。毕竟，今日可是你亲口说的，‘重新商议’。”那“重新商议”四个字，被他咬得格外清晰。嚣张！狂妄！这是所有人心中唯一的念头。萧清雪的娇躯微不可察地一颤，她没想到楚皓会答应得如此干脆，更没想到他会反将一军。她深深地看了楚皓一眼，那眼神复杂难明，最终只是冷哼一声：“我萧清雪一言九鼎。三个月后，我等着看你的表现。若是做不到，后果……你自负！”说罢，她转身对萧云峰道：“萧长老，我们走。”萧云峰虽然心有不甘，但也知道萧清雪的决定不容更改，而且今日楚皓展露的实力确实诡异，再纠缠下去，萧家的脸面也未必好看。他冷冷地瞪了楚皓一眼，拂袖而去。萧家一行人来也匆匆，去也匆匆，转眼便消失在了楚家大门外。随着他们的离开，大厅内那股压抑的气氛才稍稍缓和，但所有人的目光，依旧如同探照灯一般，死死地钉在楚皓身上，充满了震惊、疑惑，以及一丝难以名状的……期待？这个曾经的废物，真的能在三个月内，创造奇迹吗？
content_en:
The pride and ferocious smile on Lin Yun's face instantly froze, replaced by deep shock and disbelief.How is it possible?!His punch was filled with all the strength of the ninth level of the body quenching realm. Even a piece of bluestone was enough to create cracks!But Chu Hao, this loser, this guy who was rumored to have not even broken through to the fourth level of the Body Tempering Realm, actually... actually caught it so lightly?No, absolutely impossible!It must be an illusion!"Let me... open!" Lin Yun roared angrily, with veins popping up in his arms, trying to pull his fist out of Chu Hao's grasp, or, to go one step further, knock Chu Hao back.However, Chu Hao's palm was like an iron pliers, no, stronger than an iron pliers, and could not move at all.Lin Yun felt as if his fist had hit an ancient sacred mountain, and all his power disappeared without a trace like a mud cow into the sea.There was a faint, almost joking smile on Chu Hao's lips, and his wrists tightened slightly."Crack!" There was a tooth-piercing sound, accompanied by Lin Yun's sudden scream."Ah——!" Lin Yun felt an irresistible force coming from Chu Hao's palm. His finger bones and wrist bones seemed to be crushed to pieces, and severe pain swept through his whole body like a tide.He could even clearly feel that the joints in his fists were dislocating and deforming!"Hiss—" A gasp of cold air echoed in the hall.The guests who were waiting to see Chu Hao's joke almost had their eyes popping out at this moment."What...what's going on?" "Chu Hao...isn't he the third level of body tempering?" "Lin Yun is at the peak of the ninth level of body tempering! One move...no, it's not even a move, and he was restrained?" Chu Shanhe's face turned pale. He opened his mouth wide, and his mind went blank as he looked at the scene in front of him.Is this still his useless son?Chu Hao looked at Lin Yun's face twisted in pain, and chuckled: "With such a little bit of knowledge, how dare you imitate others and show your strength? Noisy." Before he finished speaking, he flicked his wrist casually.Lin Yun's body of more than 100 kilograms was like a dilapidated scarecrow, which was thrown away by Chu Hao."Huh-bang! Crash-" Lin Yun drew an awkward arc in the air, knocking over two or three mahogany tables one after another. Cups and dishes shattered on the ground, and finally fell heavily to the ground, stirring up a cloud of dust."Pfft -" As soon as he landed, he spat out a large mouthful of blood. His face was as pale as paper. He struggled to get up, but he felt severe pain in his chest, and the bones in his body seemed to be falling apart, and he couldn't raise the slightest strength.When he looked at Chu Hao again, there was no arrogance in his eyes, only deep fear and resentment.One move!No, it's not even a move!Lin Yun, the leader of the younger generation in Qingyang City, who had half-stepped into the Qi Condensation Realm, was just... defeated?Defeated so completely, so neatly!The entire Chu family hall fell into a strange dead silence.You can hear the needle drop.Everyone's eyes were focused on the young man who was still standing there, as relaxed and carefree as if he had just swatted a fly.Chu Hao, the good-for-nothing and mediocre waste in their minds, was now like an unsheathed sword, with its sharp edge so sharp that no one dared to look directly at him.For the first time, violent waves appeared in Xiao Qingxue's phoenix eyes, as cold as autumn water.She stared at Chu Hao closely, with a rare hint of surprise on that beautiful face.This "fiancé" whom she had just regarded as a shame and wanted to end the relationship immediately, could actually hide such strength?Thirty years to the east of the river, thirty years to the west of the river, don't bully young people into poverty... That arrogant sentence echoed in her mind at the moment, and it actually had a different meaning.Could it be that he wasn't bluffing?"Little beast! How dare you do such a heavy blow!" A thunderous roar broke the silence.Xiao Yunfeng's face was livid, his beard was flaring, and a terrifying coercion belonging to a strong man in the Spirit Gathering Realm surged towards Chu Hao like a real tide.The air in the hall seemed to have solidified. Guests with weaker cultivation levels only felt that their chests were tight and they had difficulty breathing. What's more, their legs were so weak that they almost collapsed to the ground.

"You are seeking death for hurting someone who is favored by my Xiao family!" Xiao Yunfeng's eyes surged with murderous intent, and he was obviously truly angry.Although Lin Yun is not from the Xiao family, he stood up for Xiao Qingxue. Now being humiliatingly defeated by Chu Hao in front of him is equivalent to a slap in the Xiao family's face.However, in the face of this pressure that was enough to make a body-tempering warrior's liver and gallbladder burst, Chu Hao just patted his palms gently, as if dusting away non-existent dust.He even stretched, his bones crackling softly, and an indescribable feeling of relief spread throughout his body.The Holy Body of Chaos is indeed extraordinary!After just the initial awakening, the strength of this physical body is already so astonishing, and even the pressure of the gathering spirit realm seems to have been weakened by most of it.He raised his eyelids and looked calmly at the furious Xiao Yunfeng, with a vague smile at the corner of his mouth: "If you are not as skilled as others, you deserve to be beaten. Why, the older one can't beat him, so the younger one can't fight back? Or is it that Elder Xiao plans to go down personally and bully the younger ones?" "You!" Xiao Yunfeng was so angry that he was furious. This kid not only defeated Lin Yun, but also dared to contradict him like this!He is a dignified elder of the Xiao family and a strong man in the spirit gathering realm. How has he ever been provoked like this?"What a sharp-tongued boy! Today I will discipline and discipline you for your parents!" Xiao Yunfeng shouted angrily, his energy surged in his body, and he was about to take action boldly.At this moment, a cold voice sounded."Elder Xiao, wait a minute." Xiao Qingxue moved lightly, walked to the field, and stood between Chu Hao and Xiao Yunfeng.She was still dressed in white, free from dust, but at this moment, her eyes looking at Chu Hao were full of unprecedented complexity.There was shock, scrutiny, and a hint of imperceptible... curiosity.She took a deep breath, looked away from Chu Hao, turned to Xiao Yunfeng, and bowed slightly: "Elder Xiao, this happened because of me, please calm down the thunderous anger." Xiao Yunfeng frowned: "Qingxue, this kid..." Xiao Qingxue interrupted him, and looked at Chu Hao again, her voice was still cold, but a little more solemn: "ChuHao, your strength is indeed beyond everyone's expectations, including me." She paused and seemed to be considering her words, then continued after a moment: "You humiliated my Xiao family first, but it is also true that Lin Yun provoked you.I can put aside your arrogance and hurtful actions today." As soon as this statement came out, everyone was shocked.Xiao Qingxue actually... stopped pursuing it?Chu Hao raised his eyebrows and looked at her with interest, wondering what kind of medicine this proud woman was selling in her gourd.Just listen to Xiao Qingxue continue: "In three months, there will be the Qingyang Competition held every three years in Qingyang City. At that time, all the leaders of the younger generation in Qingyang City will participate. If you can win the first place in that competition..." When she said this, a sharp light flashed in her cold eyes, and she locked them tightly.Chu Hao: "If you can win the first prize, the humiliation you, my family, and you have done to me today can be written off in one go, and even... we can renegotiate other things. But, if you can't do it..." She didn't finish her words, but the threat and coldness in her unfinished words made everyone shudder.The leader of Qingyang Competition?There was a burst of irrepressible discussion in the hall."Are you kidding? The Qingyang Competition to be the leader? That is the stage for Qi Condensation Realm masters!" "Even if Chu Hao hides his strength, he will reach the peak of the Body Tempering Realm if he reaches the sky, right? Wanting to be the leader is a fool's dream!" "Miss Xiao has clearly given him an impossible task!" Chu Shanhe's heart sank to the bottom. This condition is not much better than falling out directly.However, to everyone's surprise, when Chu Hao heard the words, not only did he not show any fear, but he raised the corners of his mouth slightly, revealing a confident smile: "Qingyang Dabi leader?" He stretched out his little finger, lazily picked out his ears, as if he didn't hear clearly, then he stared straight into Xiao Qingxue's deep phoenix eyes: "Okay,I, Chu Hao, have taken over!It’s only three months for the Qingyang Competition. That’s enough.”He paused, with a hint of amusement in his smile: “I just hope that Miss Xiao won’t go back on her word.After all, you said it yourself, ‘re-negotiation.’” The word “re-negotiation” was very clear to him.Arrogant!Arrogant!This is the only thought in everyone's mind.Xiao Qingxue's delicate body trembled imperceptibly. She did not expect that Chu Hao would agree so simply, let alone that he would turn an army against him.She took a deep look at Chu Hao, her eyes were complicated and unreadable, and in the end she just snorted: "I, Xiao Qingxue, keep my word. After three months, I'll wait to see your performance. If you can't do it, the consequences... you are at your own risk!" After that, she turned around.He said to Xiao Yunfeng: "Elder Xiao, let's go." Although Xiao Yunfeng was unwilling to do so, he also knew that Xiao Qingxue's decision could not be changed, and the strength shown by Chu Hao today was indeed strange. If they continued to struggle, the Xiao family might not look good.He glared at Chu Hao coldly and walked away.The Xiao family's group came and went in a hurry, and disappeared outside the Chu family's gate in a blink of an eye.As they left, the depressing atmosphere in the hall eased slightly, but everyone's eyes were still like searchlights, fixed on Chu Hao, full of shock, doubt, and a trace of indescribable...expectation?Can this former waste really create miracles in three months?
title_en: Recommended popular novels that have been completed

林云脸上的得意与狞笑瞬间凝固，取而代之的是浓浓的骇然与不可置信。怎么可能？！他这一拳，灌注了淬体境九重的全力，就算是一块青石，也足以轰出裂纹！可楚皓这个废物，这个传闻中连淬体境四重都未突破的家伙，竟然……竟然如此轻描淡写地接住了？不，绝不可能！一定是错觉！“给我……开！”林云怒吼，手臂青筋暴起，试图将拳头从楚皓的掌握中抽出，或者，更进一步，将楚皓整个人震退。然而，楚皓的手掌如同一只铁钳，不，比铁钳更为坚固，纹丝不动。林云感觉自己的拳头像是轰在了一座太古神山之上，所有的力量都如泥牛入海，消失得无影无踪。楚皓嘴角噙着一抹淡淡的，甚至可以说是戏谑的笑容，手腕微微一紧。“咔嚓！”一声令人牙酸的轻响，伴随着林云骤然拔高的惨叫。“啊——！”林云只觉得一股无法抗拒的巨力从楚皓的掌心传来，他的指骨、腕骨仿佛都要被生生捏碎，剧痛如潮水般瞬间席卷全身。他甚至能清晰地感觉到，自己拳头上的骨节正在错位、变形！“嘶——”大厅内，响起一片倒吸凉气的声音。那些原本等着看楚皓笑话的宾客，此刻一个个眼珠子都快瞪出来了。“这……这怎么回事？”“楚皓他……他不是淬体三重吗？”“林云可是淬体九重巅峰啊！一招……不，连一招都算不上，就被制住了？”楚山河更是面如土色，他张大了嘴，看着眼前这一幕，大脑一片空白。这个还是他那个不成器的儿子吗？楚皓看着林云痛得扭曲的脸，轻笑一声：“就这点微末道行，也敢学人强出头？聒噪。”话音未落，他手腕随意一抖。林云那一百多斤的身体，就像一个破败的稻草人，被楚皓轻飘飘地甩了出去。“呼——砰！哗啦啦——”林云在空中划过一道狼狈的弧线，接连撞翻了两三张红木桌案，杯盘碗碟碎裂一地，最后重重摔在地上，激起一片尘土。“噗——”他刚一落地，便猛地喷出一大口鲜血，脸色惨白如纸，挣扎着想要爬起来，却感觉胸口剧痛，浑身骨头像散了架一般，提不起丝毫力气。他再看向楚皓时，那眼神中哪还有半分倨傲，只剩下深深的恐惧与怨毒。一招！不，甚至连一招都算不上！青阳城年轻一代的翘楚，半只脚踏入凝气境的林云，就这么……败了？败得如此彻底，如此干脆利落！整个楚家大厅，陷入了一种诡异的死寂。落针可闻。所有人的目光，都汇聚在那个依旧站在原地，仿佛只是拍了拍苍蝇般轻松写意的少年身上。楚皓，这个他们印象中唯唯诺诺、资质平庸的废物，此刻却如同一柄出鞘的利剑，锋芒毕露，令人不敢直视。萧清雪那双清冷如秋水的凤眸中，第一次泛起了剧烈的波澜。她紧紧盯着楚皓，那张绝美的容颜上，罕见地露出一丝讶异。这个刚刚还被她视作耻辱，恨不得立刻撇清关系的“未婚夫”，竟然隐藏着如此实力？三十年河东，三十年河西，莫欺少年穷……那句狂言，此刻在她脑海中回荡，竟有了一丝别样的意味。难道，他并非虚张声势？“小畜生！你竟敢下如此重手！”一声雷霆般的怒吼打破了寂静。萧云峰脸色铁青，须发戟张，一股属于聚灵境强者的恐怖威压，如同实质的潮水般向楚皓汹涌而去。大厅内的空气仿佛都凝固了，修为稍弱的宾客只觉得胸口发闷，呼吸困难，更有甚者双腿发软，几乎要瘫倒在地。

“伤我萧家看中的人，你找死！”萧云峰眼中杀机暴涌，显然是动了真怒。林云虽然不是萧家人，但他是为了萧清雪出头，如今当着他的面被楚皓如此羞辱性地击败，等同于打了萧家的脸。然而，面对这股足以让淬体境武者肝胆俱裂的威压，楚皓却只是轻轻拍了拍手掌，仿佛掸去根本不存在的灰尘。他甚至还伸了个懒腰，骨骼发出一阵噼里啪啦的轻响，一种难以言喻的舒畅感传遍全身。混沌圣体，果然非同凡响！仅仅是初步觉醒，这肉身强度便已如此惊人，连聚灵境的威压，似乎也削弱了大半。他抬起眼皮，平静地看向暴怒的萧云峰，嘴角勾起一抹若有若无的弧度：“技不如人，挨打也是活该。怎么，老的打不过，小的就不能还手了？还是说，萧长老打算亲自下场，以大欺小？”“你！”萧云峰气得七窍生烟，这小子不仅废了林云，还敢如此顶撞他！他堂堂萧家长老，聚灵境强者，何曾受过这等挑衅？“好个牙尖嘴利的小子！今日老夫便替你爹娘好好管教管教你！”萧云峰怒喝一声，体内元力鼓荡，眼看就要悍然出手。就在这时，一道清冷的声音响起。“萧长老，且慢。”萧清雪莲步轻移，走到了场中，挡在了楚皓与萧云峰之间。她依旧是一身白衣，不染尘埃，但此刻，她那双看向楚皓的眸子，却充满了前所未有的复杂。有震惊，有审视，也有一丝难以察觉的……好奇。她深吸一口气，目光从楚皓身上移开，转向萧云峰，微微欠身：“萧长老，此事因我而起，还请长老暂息雷霆之怒。”萧云峰眉头一皱：“清雪，这小子……”萧清雪却打断了他，再次看向楚皓，声音清冷依旧，却多了一分郑重：“楚皓，你的实力，的确出乎了所有人的意料，也包括我。”她顿了顿，似乎在斟酌措辞，片刻后才继续说道：“今日之事，你羞辱我萧家在先，但林云挑衅你也是事实。我可以暂且不追究你今日的狂言与出手伤人。”此言一出，满座皆惊。萧清雪竟然……不追究了？楚皓挑了挑眉，饶有兴致地看着她，想知道这位天之骄女葫芦里卖的什么药。只听萧清雪继续道：“三个月后，便是青阳城三年一度的青阳大比。届时，青阳城所有年轻一辈的翘楚都会参加。你若能在那场大比中，夺得魁首……”她说到这里，清冷的目光中闪过一丝锐利的光芒，紧紧锁住楚皓：“若你能夺魁，今日你我两家以及你对我的羞辱，可以一笔勾销，甚至……我们可以重新商议其他。但，倘若你做不到……”她没有把话说完，但那未尽之言中的威胁与冰冷，却让在场所有人都打了个寒颤。青阳大比魁首？大厅内顿时响起一阵压抑不住的议论声。“开什么玩笑？青阳大比魁首？那可是凝气境高手的舞台！”“楚皓就算隐藏了实力，顶天了也就淬体境巅峰吧？想拿魁首，痴人说梦！”“萧小姐这分明是给了他一个不可能完成的任务啊！”楚山河一颗心更是沉到了谷底，这条件，比直接翻脸好不了多少。然而，出乎所有人意料，楚皓闻言，非但没有丝毫惧色，反而嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹自信的笑容：“青阳大比魁首么？”他伸出小指，懒洋洋地掏了掏耳朵，仿佛没听清一般，随即目光一凝，直视萧清雪那双深邃的凤眸：“好，我楚皓接下了！区区青阳大比魁首而已，三个月，足够了。”他顿了顿，笑容中带着一丝玩味：“只希望到时候，萧小姐可不要食言才好。毕竟，今日可是你亲口说的，‘重新商议’。”那“重新商议”四个字，被他咬得格外清晰。嚣张！狂妄！这是所有人心中唯一的念头。萧清雪的娇躯微不可察地一颤，她没想到楚皓会答应得如此干脆，更没想到他会反将一军。她深深地看了楚皓一眼，那眼神复杂难明，最终只是冷哼一声：“我萧清雪一言九鼎。三个月后，我等着看你的表现。若是做不到，后果……你自负！”说罢，她转身对萧云峰道：“萧长老，我们走。”萧云峰虽然心有不甘，但也知道萧清雪的决定不容更改，而且今日楚皓展露的实力确实诡异，再纠缠下去，萧家的脸面也未必好看。他冷冷地瞪了楚皓一眼，拂袖而去。萧家一行人来也匆匆，去也匆匆，转眼便消失在了楚家大门外。随着他们的离开，大厅内那股压抑的气氛才稍稍缓和，但所有人的目光，依旧如同探照灯一般，死死地钉在楚皓身上，充满了震惊、疑惑，以及一丝难以名状的……期待？这个曾经的废物，真的能在三个月内，创造奇迹吗？
